e.body:
**SEDDK**（Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu，**土耳其保险与私人养老金监管与监督局**）是**土耳其的保险与私人养老金监管机构**。本条目是本轮**市场覆盖轴**的产物：实测检索发现本 wiki 池内**与土耳其相关的条目为 0**，而土耳其有几个对本领域特别相关的制度特征——**强制地震险（DASK）**、**私人养老金体系 BES**、以及**参与制（伊斯兰）保险**。

可核实信息（**均为本次 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 46KB；**报告中心 `/tr/raporlar`** 23KB，下设三类：**① 机构活动报告**（`/tr/raporlar/kurum-faaliyet`）；**② `Sigortacılık ve BES Faaliyet Raporları`（保险与 BES 活动报告）** 73KB——页面内实测挂有 **「Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Sektörü Gelişmeler ve Temel Göstergeler Raporu」（保险与私人养老金行业发展与关键指标报告）**，含 **2025 年 1–12 月**、**2025 年 1–6 月**、**2024 年 1–12 月** 等期次，以及 **2021 / 2020 年度保险与 BES 活动报告**（2019 年报告按章分册）；**③ `Sigorta, Reasürans ve Emeklilik Şirketlerinin Mali Tabloları`（保险、再保与养老金公司财务报表）** 28KB；另有**公司名录页** `/tr/kuruluslar/sigorta-reasurans-ve-bes-sirketleri` 78KB。页面中还实测到**官方公报（Resmî Gazete）2026-08-21 关于强制地震险一般条款修订**的链接、**参与制保险与私人养老金**的 2026 年第 26 号通函，以及**私人健康险（ÖSS）新阶段指南 PDF**。

对 RIAA：**① 补的是「市场覆盖」而非「窗口」**——池内既有监管数据源覆盖美国、欧盟、英国、澳洲、日本、韩国、台湾、香港、中国内地、印度、新加坡、马来西亚、加拿大、菲律宾、印尼等（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]），**土耳其此前完全缺席**；SEDDK 的「行业发展与关键指标报告」+「公司财务报表」正好是**市场概览**与**公司层面**两个常用层次。**② 制度上的独特价值**——土耳其的**强制地震险（DASK）**是全球**巨灾强制保险**的重要案例（与新西兰 EQC、日本地震保险并列），而**私人养老金 BES** 是**新兴市场自愿性养老储蓄**的样本；两者都可与池内 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 对照。**③ 区域监管框架对照**——可与 [[iais-icp]]（IAIS 核心原则）、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 一起用于**监管体系比较**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 内容以土耳其语为主**（本次未发现并核实英文版），**语言门槛真实存在**；**②** 本次核实到**站点页面结构与 PDF 链接**（发布会话页、报告文件链接均实测），**但未打开任何 PDF**，因此**不能确认报告内部口径与数据质量**；**③** 部分文件由 `UploadContent`/`upload` 路径提供，**链接稳定性未经长期验证**；**④** 本条目仅主张「该监管机构的公开报告入口可用」，**不主张其数据可直接用于定价或合规判断**。**核实说明**：首页、报告中心、两类报告页、公司名录页均 HTTP 200 实测（46KB / 23KB / 73KB / 28KB / 78KB），并抓取页面内真实 PDF 链接与标题、公报链接；**未下载或打开任何 PDF**。
e.body_en:
**SEDDK** (Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu — **Turkey’s Insurance and Private Pension Regulation and Supervision Agency**) is **the Turkish regulator for insurance and private pensions**. This entry comes from this round’s **market-coverage axis**: a measured search showed **zero Turkey-related entries** in the corpus, while Turkey has several institutionally distinctive features for this field — **compulsory earthquake insurance (DASK)**, the **private pension system BES**, and **participation (Islamic) insurance**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200 in this check**): the homepage is 46KB; the **reports hub `/tr/raporlar`** is 23KB with three families: **① institutional activity reports** (`/tr/raporlar/kurum-faaliyet`); **② `Sigortacılık ve BES Faaliyet Raporları` (insurance and BES activity reports)** at 73KB, whose page carries the **"Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Sektörü Gelişmeler ve Temel Göstergeler Raporu" (Insurance and Private Pension Sector Developments and Key Indicators Report)** covering **Jan–Dec 2025**, **Jan–Jun 2025** and **Jan–Dec 2024** among other periods, plus **2021 and 2020 annual insurance and BES activity reports** (2019 reports split into sections); **③ `Sigorta, Reasürans ve Emeklilik Şirketlerinin Mali Tabloları` (financial statements of insurance, reinsurance and pension companies)** at 28KB; and a **company register** page `/tr/kuruluslar/sigorta-reasurans-ve-bes-sirketleri` at 78KB. The pages also contain a measured link to the **Official Gazette (Resmî Gazete) amendment of 2026-08-21 to the compulsory earthquake insurance general conditions**, a 2026 circular on **participation insurance and private pensions**, and a **private health insurance (ÖSS) new-period guide PDF**.

For RIAA: **① this fills a market gap rather than a time-window one** — the corpus’s regulator data sources cover the US, EU, UK, Australia, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, mainland China, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Canada, the Philippines and Indonesia ([[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[japan-life-insurance-statistics]], [[fss-korea-insurance]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[osfi-canada-data]], [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]]), but **Turkey was entirely absent**; SEDDK’s "sector developments and key indicators" reports plus company financial statements supply exactly the two most-used levels — **market overview** and **company-level**. **② Institutional value** — Turkey’s **compulsory earthquake insurance (DASK)** is a major global case of **compulsory catastrophe insurance** (alongside New Zealand’s EQC and Japan’s earthquake scheme), and the **BES private pension system** is a sample of **voluntary retirement saving in an emerging market**; both can be read against [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[openquake-engine]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]], [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]. **③ Regulatory comparison** — pair it with [[iais-icp]] (IAIS core principles), [[insurance-europe]] and [[oecd-insurance-data]] for cross-jurisdiction work.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the content is predominantly in Turkish** (no English version was found or verified here), so **a real language barrier exists**; **②** this check verified the **site structure and PDF links** (publication pages and report file links were measured) **but opened no PDF**, so **the reports’ internal definitions and data quality cannot be confirmed**; **③** some files are served from `UploadContent`/`upload` paths, so **long-term link stability was not verified**; **④** this entry claims only that **the regulator’s public report entry point works**, and **does not claim its data can be used directly for pricing or compliance decisions**. **Verification note**: the homepage, reports hub, both report pages and the company register page were all measured at HTTP 200 (46KB / 23KB / 73KB / 28KB / 78KB), with real in-page PDF links and titles plus the gazette link extracted; **no PDF was downloaded or opened**.
e.body_hk:
**SEDDK**（Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu，**土耳其保險與私人養老金監管與監督局**）是**土耳其的保險與私人養老金監管機構**。本條目是本輪**市場覆蓋軸**的產物：實測檢索顯示本 wiki 池內**土耳其相關條目為 0**，而土耳其有幾個對本領域特別相關的制度特徵——**強制地震險（DASK）**、**私人養老金體系 BES**、以及**參與制（伊斯蘭）保險**。

可核實資訊（**均為本次 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 46KB；**報告中心 `/tr/raporlar`** 23KB，下設三類：**① 機構活動報告**；**② 保險與 BES 活動報告頁** 73KB——頁面內實測掛有**「保險與私人養老金行業發展與關鍵指標報告」**，含 **2025 年 1–12 月**、**2025 年 1–6 月**、**2024 年 1–12 月**，以及 **2021 / 2020 年度保險與 BES 活動報告**；**③ 保險、再保與養老金公司財務報表頁** 28KB；另有**公司名錄頁** 78KB。頁面中還實測到**官方公報 2026-08-21 關於強制地震險一般條款修訂**的鏈接、**參與制保險與私人養老金**的 2026 年第 26 號通函。

對 RIAA：**① 補的是「市場覆蓋」而非「時間窗」**——池內監管數據源覆蓋美、歐、英、澳、日、韓、台、港、內地、印度、新加坡、馬來西亞、加拿大、菲律賓、印尼等（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]），**土耳其此前完全缺席**。**② 制度價值**——**強制地震險 DASK** 是全球**巨災強制保險**的重要案例，**BES** 是新興市場自願性養老儲蓄樣本，可與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 對照。**③** 可與 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 一起用於監管體系比較。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 內容以土耳其語為主**（本次未發現並核實英文版）；**②** 本次核實到**站點結構與 PDF 鏈接**，**但未打開任何 PDF**，故**不能確認報告內部口徑與數據質量**；**③** 部分文件由 `UploadContent`/`upload` 路徑提供，**鏈接穩定性未經長期驗證**；**④** 本條目僅主張**該監管機構的公開報告入口可用**，**不主張其數據可直接用於定價或合規判斷**。**核實說明**：首頁、報告中心、兩類報告頁、公司名錄頁均 HTTP 200 實測，並抓取頁內真實 PDF 鏈接與標題；**未下載或打開任何 PDF**。
